maxStores.title: Maximum stores to check
maxStores.description: How many stores from Rakuten's directory to check, in directory order. Set 0 to check every store (about 4,200; takes roughly 35 minutes).

storeKeywords.title: Only stores matching
storeKeywords.description: Only check stores whose Rakuten name contains one of these words, e.g. nike, hotel, beauty. Leave empty for all stores.

minRatePercent.title: Minimum cash back (%)
minRatePercent.description: Only save stores paying at least this percentage. Stores with a fixed amount (e.g. $25) are always saved.

includeNoCashback.title: Include stores without cash back
includeNoCashback.description: Also save stores that are listed on Rakuten but currently pay no cash back, or whose rate could not be read.
